runtime_deviations: Matplotlib uses the Agg backend for headless evaluation.
vggt.utils.geometry and vggt.utils.pose_enc imports are deferred to infer_vggt_and_reconstruct to isolate model namespaces.
load_gt_pointcloud accepts an explicit validated PLY file path in addition to the original dataset-root layout.
Newer evo dual-alignment rejection is handled by explicitly reproducing official evo 1.32.0 behavior: Sim(3) alignment followed by origin alignment.

FastVGGT pose_enc is converted to float32 before camera decoding and the shared depth unprojection, preventing BF16 quaternion rounding from producing non-rigid camera matrices; model forward remains BF16.
protocol_notes: Protocol fastvggt_scannet_evo132 intentionally uses official evo 1.32.0 dual alignment: normalized GT and predicted poses are evaluated as w2c trajectories with Sim(3) followed by origin alignment, while geometry receives a separate bbox center/diagonal scale alignment before seed-33, 100000-point cap, 5cm voxel, summed bidirectional clipped Chamfer distance.
